newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil air force plane disappears.
newsitem.headline: Brazil air force plane disappears.

text.p: A Brazilian air force plane with four crew disappeared Wednesday and authorities said they did not know what had happened to it.

The C-95 Bandeirantes aircraft, which had been involved in parachuting exercises, went missing between Resende in Rio de Janeiro state and Sao Jose dos Campos in Sao Paulo state, an Aviation Ministry spokesman said.
"We don't know whether the aircraft crashed, all we know is that contact with the plane broke off at 10:15 this morning (1315 GMT) and it hasn't been seen since," he said.
Air force helicopters were searching for the plane.
